name: Space Lane Raiders
legend: The Drukhari delight in launching piratical attacks on their victims’ voidships, gathering realspace raiding parties just as they would to assail an enemy world. Such close and nightmarish confines suit these raiding bands particularly well. Soon enough, the voidship rings to the screams of its defenders...

rules.name: Commorrite Rivalries
rules.legend: Even in the midst of battle, the Drukhari indulge in politicking and factionalism, seeking to outdo their rivals and cover themselves in dark glory with every murderous triumph.
rules.description_html: Each time a DRUKHARi CHARACTER model from your army destroys an enemy CHARACTER unit, you gain 1 Pain token. In addition, each time you use the Battlefield Command Stratagem, you can expend 1 Pain token from your Pain token pool. If you do, decrease that Stratagems cost by 1CP for that usage.

stratagems.name: SHIPBOARD SHADES
stratagems.type: Space Lane Raiders – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Amidst the strobing lumens and gouting steam of voidship combat, the Drukhari flicker and flit like malevolent, half-seen shadows.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One DRUKHARI unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

stratagems.name: CREW-THIEVES
stratagems.type: Space Lane Raiders – Battle Tactic Stratagem
stratagems.legend: The fast-acting incapacitation toxins on the blades of these Wracks allow them to lay low the defenders, before dragging them away, alive but powerless, to a far more horrible fate than death.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One WRAcKS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+] ability.

stratagems.name: VOIDSHIP GLADIATORS
stratagems.type: Space Lane Raiders – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: Treating the vessel they have boarded as just another arena to perform in, these Wyches turn every iota of their skill and agility to the task.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One WYcHES unit from your army that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Roll one D6: on a 2+, until the end of the turn, enemy units cannot fire Overwatch at your unit.
stratagems.description_text:

stratagems.name: VETERAN PIRATES
stratagems.type: Space Lane Raiders – Strategic Ploy Stratagem
stratagems.legend: No strangers to shipboard warfare, these warriors are skilled in loosing volleys then vanishing swiftly back behind corners and bulkheads to avoid reprisals.
stratagems.description_html:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, just after a KABALITE WARRIORS unit from your army has shot.

TARGET: That KABALITE WARRIORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to 3".

enhancements.name: Power and Greed
enhancements.legend: This warrior is addicted to the heady rush of battle and suffering, each fresh taste driving them to crave more.
enhancements.description_html: The first time in each turn that the bearer is Empowered, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Pain token.
enhancements.description_text: The first time in each turn that the bearer is Empowered, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Pain token.

enhancements.name: Spiteful Demise
enhancements.legend: Knowing all too well that the carnage they cause during this void battle may be all that pays for their revivification by the Haemonculi, this warrior strikes out viciously until their very last breath.
enhancements.description_html: When the bearer is destroyed, if it has not fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 2+, do not remove it from play. The bearer can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
